description: This file defines the MenuAdapter class for an Android application, responsible for managing and displaying menu items in a RecyclerView, including handling intents for various activities and external apps like Nextcloud Files.

classes.name: MenuAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for displaying menu items in a RecyclerView, handling item creation, binding, and intent generation for menu actions.

methods.name: MenuAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing menu items with intents and resources, setting up click handling and styling.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Updates the color theme of the menu and refreshes the display.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a stable ID for each menu item based on position.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder for a menu item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder for display.

methods.name: updateAccount
methods.description: Updates the intent for the trashbin menu item based on the current account.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of menu items.

methods.name: generateTrashbinIntent
methods.description: Generates an intent to open the trashbin, either via app or web, depending on version and availability.

methods.name: generateTrashbinAppIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to open the trashbin activity within the Nextcloud Files app.

methods.name: generateTrashbinWebIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to open the trashbin in a web browser.
